$schema_note: Provider-neutral integration contract for AbroadMate/ThailandMate launch funnel. Contains field and event definitions only - no credentials, API keys, endpoints, or provider-specific code.
status: pre-implementation specification; review by privacy/legal reviewer required before any integration is switched on
principles: Minimum data by design; each field names the single store that owns it (system of record).
Email provider is the system of record for identity/consent; analytics receives enumerated, non-PII events only; payment provider owns all card/billing data; corrections register owns report content.
Analytics allow-list: only the events and enum properties listed here may ever be sent. Free text, emails, documents, income figures and personal notes are never analytics properties.
No field in this contract may carry passport, visa, bank, card, medical, exact-income, employer or document data. Such data is never requested.
Provider-neutral: field names are abstract; adapters map them to whichever provider is chosen per abroadmate-final-stack-recommendation.md.

fields.name: email_signup
fields.description: A visitor explicitly submitted the signup form with consent. Creates a contact record in the email provider.
fields.pii: contains email address - EMAIL PROVIDER ONLY
fields.analytics_value: count event email_signup_submitted/email_signup_confirmed only; email string never sent

fields.name: audience
fields.description: Self-selected primary audience, if the visitor volunteers it.
fields.store: email_provider (custom field, only after consent); analytics (enum property)

fields.name: destination
fields.description: City/edition of interest, if selected. Defaults to bangkok for the Bangkok launch.
fields.store: email_provider (custom field, after consent); analytics (enum property)

fields.name: source_page
fields.description: Path/slug of the page where the action happened (no query string that may contain tokens/emails).
fields.pii: no when sanitised to path only

fields.name: campaign
fields.description: Marketing campaign label (e.g. launch_list_2026q3). Controlled list, not free text.

fields.name: consent_timestamp
fields.description: When the visitor gave consent (and when double opt-in was confirmed).
fields.store: email_provider (system of record); copy kept with welcome-copy version in repo
fields.analytics_value: not sent (no timestamp-by-user); aggregate counts only

fields.name: consent_copy_version
fields.description: Version id of the consent wording shown (e.g. privacy-copy-2026-08-28), so the exact promise is auditable.

fields.name: unsubscribe_status
fields.description: Subscription/suppression state. Unsubscribe must be one-click and suppression permanent.

fields.name: pack_interest_action
fields.description: Highest funnel step the contact reached regarding Bangkok First 90 Days.

fields.name: price_variant
fields.description: Which offer/variant the visitor saw or reserved. Never a free-text price the visitor entered.
fields.store: email_provider (tag); analytics (property); payment provider (order metadata as enum)
fields.analytics_value: enum label allowed, not amount free text

fields.name: checkout_status
fields.description: Outcome state from the payment provider's webhook/redirect. Card data is never present.
fields.store: payment_provider (system of record); minimal status mirrored to email_provider for delivery; analytics receives status enum + optional amount band label only
fields.analytics_value: enum status allowed; never card, billing address, or buyer email

fields.name: contact_email
fields.description: The email address itself. Listed for completeness; it lives ONLY in the email provider and (for a purchase) the payment provider's transaction record. Not in analytics, not in the corrections register for reports.
fields.store: email_provider (marketing consent) and payment_provider (transactional receipt); analytics NEVER; corrections register only if a reporter supplies it for a reply, kept in the private register, never analytics

events.fires: visitor opens checklist or budget planner
visitor reaches the payment provider's checkout
payment provider webhook/redirect returns a state

email_provider.notes: System of record for identity and consent. Must support one-click unsubscribe and suppression. Tags are enums/controlled labels. Purchaser emails received from the payment provider are transactional unless separately consented to marketing.

analytics.notes: Cookieless provider preferred (Cloudflare Web Analytics default; Umami if custom events/goals needed). Fixed property allow-list; URLs stripped of tokens/emails; budget/checklist inputs computed client-side and never transmitted.

payment_provider.notes: All card data is entered on the payment provider's domain; the AbroadMate site never sees or stores card numbers. Merchant-of-record vs direct-merchant (own tax responsibility) depends on the chosen provider and operator jurisdiction - see final stack recommendation. Refund wording must match the provider's actual refund mechanics.

corrections_register.notes: Private register outside the public repository and outside analytics. Sensitive data sent in error is deleted same day and logged as a deletion event (date+category only). See abroadmate-report-change-workflow.md.

consent_and_retention_rules.capture: Explicit opt-in tick, not pre-checked; consent wording versioned and dated; double opt-in recommended subject to reviewer.
consent_and_retention_rules.no_bundling: Using a free tool, submitting a correction, or checking out never signs anyone up to marketing.
consent_and_retention_rules.retention: Subscribers deleted on unsubscribe within 30 days (suppression address retained only to prevent re-add); corrections anonymised after the affected refresh cycle (max 24 months); analytics aggregate only with shortest useful window; payment records retained per the tax/accounting advice for the operator's jurisdiction (do not guess).
consent_and_retention_rules.rights: Single privacy contact; access/delete requests fulfilled within 30 days; no ID documents requested.

tags.FACT: Provider cookie/PII behaviour as stated on official pages checked 2026-08-28 (Cloudflare Web Analytics and Umami: no cookies, no personal data); payment providers collect card data on their own domains.
tags.ASSUMPTION: A fixed allow-list can be enforced in a small static site; email provider custom fields can hold the enum tags; budget/checklist math runs client-side.
tags.REC: Keep email the only direct identifier; enum-only analytics properties; cookieless analytics; never wire free text or tool inputs to analytics; legal/privacy reviewer signs the contract before integrations are enabled.
